instructions: tenjin-agent is the CLI, MCP server, and hooks that run inside a user's coding agent and talk to the Tenjin API, paying with x402 (USDC on Base) on the user's behalf. It runs on the user's machine with their credentials, so a defect here spends their money, leaks their prompts, or reaches their local network. Report only findings that would block a merge or break in production. Every finding must name the concrete trigger and its cost; cite file:line; never infer behavior from a name. Do not report: style, naming, comment density, PR wording, missing backward compatibility (breaking changes are fine), pre-existing issues, or anything CI enforces (lint, typecheck, prettier, build). On a re-review, report only the delta.

rules.rule: Every paid call must commit its budget reservation at most once per decision. A retry, a stale 402 challenge, or a resumed session must not charge or reserve twice.

Data from one agent session (prompt, history, packet, key) must never be read or sent on behalf of another session. Any lookup that picks the newest file across sessions without a session id is a defect.

An outbound request to a provider-controlled host must connect to the address that passed the private-network check (pin the resolved address or revalidate at connect time). A DNS check followed by an unpinned fetch is a defect.

Anything that sends user content off the machine, spends money, or writes outside the data directory must pass through the consent and permission model in docs/safety-model.md and docs/agent-permissions.md.
